verses.1: This is the account of Adam’s descendants. When God created Adam, he made him in God’s likeness.
verses.2: He created him male and female, blessed them, and called their name Adam on the day they were created.
verses.3: Adam lived 130 years and fathered a son in his own likeness, in his own image. He named him Seth.
verses.4: After fathering Seth, Adam lived 800 years and fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.5: All the days that Adam lived totaled 930 years, and he died.
verses.6: Seth lived 105 years and fathered Enosh.
verses.7: After fathering Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.8: All the days that Seth lived totaled 912 years, and he died.
verses.9: Enosh lived 90 years and fathered Cainan.
verses.10: After fathering Cainan, Enosh lived 815 years and fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.11: All the days that Enosh lived totaled 905 years, and he died.
verses.12: Cainan lived 70 years and fathered Mahalalel.
verses.13: After fathering Mahalalel, Cainan lived 840 years and fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.14: All the days that Cainan lived totaled 910 years, and he died.
verses.15: Mahalalel lived 65 years and fathered Jared.
verses.16: After fathering Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.17: All the days that Mahalalel lived totaled 895 years, and he died.
verses.18: Jared lived 162 years and fathered Enoch.
verses.19: After fathering Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.20: All the days that Jared lived totaled 962 years, and he died.
verses.21: Enoch lived 65 years and fathered Methuselah.
verses.22: After fathering Methuselah, Enoch walked with God for 300 years and fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.23: All the days that Enoch lived totaled 365 years.
verses.24: Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God had taken him.
verses.25: Methuselah lived 187 years and fathered Lamech.
verses.26: After fathering Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.27: All the days that Methuselah lived totaled 969 years, and he died.
verses.28: Lamech lived 182 years and fathered a son.
verses.29: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will bring us relief from our labor and from the toil of our hands from the ground that the LORD has cursed.”
verses.30: After fathering Noah, Lamech lived 595 years and fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.31: All the days that Lamech lived totaled 777 years, and he died.
verses.32: Noah was 500 years old when he fathered Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

notes:
Notes
- v. 1: "the account of Adam’s descendants" — The Hebrew is "sefer toledot," literally "book of generations," but here it functions as an introduction to a genealogical or narrative section.
- v. 24: "he was not" — The Hebrew is "ve’einenu," literally "and he was not," referring to Enoch’s mysterious disappearance. The phrase "for God had taken him" is an interpretive gloss.
- v. 29: "relief from our labor" — The Hebrew term "machamenu" is translated here as "relief," but could also carry a more emotional tone, such as "comfort" or "consolation."

[4] After fathering Seth, Adam lived 800 years and fathered other sons and daughters.
